To assess the ability of LLMs to learn knowledge from new documents, it is essential to use a document corpus with minimal overlap with the original pre-training corpus. This ensures that when an LLM correctly answers questions, we can confidently attribute this capability to its learning from the new documents, rather than encountering similar questions in its original pre-training corpus.
